constraints.A_evidence: Four separate zippered pencil pouches are visible.
constraints.B_evidence: Only one open zippered case is visible; its compartments are not separate cases.

constraints.constraint: The four pencil cases must have different colors.
constraints.A_evidence: The four pouches are yellow, gray, pink, and blue.
constraints.B_evidence: The single visible case is black; there are no four differently colored cases.

constraints.constraint: Arrange the four pencil cases in a line.
constraints.A_evidence: The four pouches form an orderly diagonal row from front left to back right.
constraints.B_evidence: A single open case does not form a line of four cases.

judgment.reason: A shows four differently colored pencil cases lined up in a diagonal row; B shows only one black open case.
